hack.root_cause: CPIMP (Clandestine Proxy In the Middle of Proxy) — front-run proxy initialization, shadow admin installation, 78-day dormancy, then mint + drain
hack.description: USPD's proxy was front-run in a 24-second initialization window on deployment day, installing a hidden middleman that forwarded all real function calls while sitting dormant for 78 days before minting $1M in unbacked tokens.
